# `dotnet_separate_import_directive_groups`

Separate groups of usings by first namespace segment with a blank line.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `true` |  |
| `false` |  |

**Default:** `false`

## Example

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Foo.Bar;
using Baz.Qux;

namespace N;

public class Widget { }
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Foo.Bar;
using Baz.Qux;

namespace N;

public class Widget { }
```
:::

::::

*Curb recognises this key but does not yet reformat this construct — Before and After are identical.*
